properties.notes: The site comprises two parcels of land either side of the River Darent. The southern parcel is mainly scrubland but contains a barn and hardstanding. The northern parcel is scrubland. Bounded by the A25 to the south, open countryside to the east and west, and the recreation ground to the north. Mature trees line the eastern and western boundaries of the site.
